stories.title: 39 pupils and staff fall ill after eating school lunches in Sha Tin

en.title: 39 pupils and staff fall ill after eating school lunches in Sha Tin
en.summary: Hong Kong health authorities are investigating suspected food poisoning affecting 39 people at Baptist Lui Ming Choi Primary School in Sha Tin who consumed school lunches on Wednesday. The affected individuals, including 37 students aged 5-11 and two staff members, developed gastrointestinal symptoms within 8-22 hours.
